_comment: Composable-music mood table for scripts/music_director.gd. A mood = a set of stems (sounds/music/loops/<id>.ogg) each held at a target volume in dB; set_mood() crossfades the live mix toward it. Stem prompts/list live in tools/music-bake/palette.py. ONE table, no per-mood branching code (collection-fork policy). 0 dB = full; negative = quieter. Missing stem files are tolerated (that track just stays silent) so a half-baked library never crashes the game.
_melodic_note: Non-looping stems the director plays once then replays after a randomized rest (lonely-phrase feel). braam_danger is a one-shot impact, so it belongs here too — it surfaces as occasional ominous swells during the crisis, NOT a stuttering loop.

crisis_intensity._comment: While the crisis mood is active, scrubber_level (0..100, lower = worse) lerps these stems' gain: at full charge they sit near min_db (barely there), at empty they reach the mood's authored target. Makes the air crisis musically tighten as O2 drains.

rooms._comment: current_room_id -> base mood. Anything not listed uses defaults.default_room_mood. gate_room stays calm here; gate_room.gd overrides it during cinematics.

quest_steps._comment: Active quest step -> mood override (beats the room mood). The air-crisis spine plays as crisis until the scrubber is repaired.
